codeReview.summary: Final code review approved the NPC Move Route implementation with no blockers.

manualQa.summary: Manual QA matrix covers page route UI, event-command route UI, runtime movement, side effects, import validation, typecheck, build, and browser evidence.

criteriaCoverage.originalIntent: Korean movement type and move route settings create actually moving NPCs with complex route planning and every route command family working.
criteriaCoverage.desiredOutcome: Users can author page-owned and event-command routes in Korean UI; runtime NPCs move across map coordinates and execute side effects.
criteriaCoverage.userOutcomeReview: Evidence includes 16 runtime screenshots, coordinate summaries, audio state, saved route extraction, Playwright UI screenshots, and passing automated checks.

iteration.summary: Prior review blockers for movement frequency, stale page-owned movers, and event-command route catalog drift were fixed and retested.
